name: patient_sex_is_female_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient's current sex is female.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current sex is documented as female.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current sex is documented as not female (i.e., male or other).
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current sex is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_sex_is_male_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient's current sex is male.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current sex is documented as male.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current sex is documented as not male (i.e., female or other).
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current sex is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_finding_of_body_mass_index_value_recorded_now_withunit_kg_per_m2
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current body mass index (BMI) in kg/m².
when_unknown: Set to null if no BMI measurement is recorded now or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured BMI value in kg/m² if a BMI measurement is recorded now.

name: patient_has_finding_of_abnormal_thyroid_hormone_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has abnormal thyroid hormone levels.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has abnormal thyroid hormone levels.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have abnormal thyroid hormone levels.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has abnormal thyroid hormone levels.

name: patient_has_finding_of_thyroid_stimulating_hormone_level_above_reference_range_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a high thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) level.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a high thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) level.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a high thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) level.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a high thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) level.
